The '''Geonosian south warehouse''' was located in the [[Northern Windfarm]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The warehouse was used by local criminals to store [[Spice/Legends|spice]] before [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] invaded the area and took over the compound.<ref name="TOR:BO" />
